channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Rockbridge Network: a rede obscura dos EUA que teria ligações com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Rockbridge Network, a US conservative network linked to the Republican Party and figures like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance, is suspected of having ties to candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT party requested the Brazilian Supreme Court to investigate possible illegal foreign funding of Flávio's campaign, based on unsubstantiated claims made by candidate Renan Santos. Founded in 2019 by Christopher Buskirk, the network aimed to mobilize disaffected donors to support disruptive Republican agendas.

item.title: Flávio pede que Fux derrube decisão de Dino sobre posts de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign requested Supreme Court Minister Luiz Fux to suspend Minister Flávio Dino's decision, which allowed the posting of a false news item about the candidate allegedly intending to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Lula avança entre católicos, evangélicos e mulheres após fim das bets
item.description: A Quaest poll shows President Lula (PT) gained five percentage points among Catholic voters following the announcement of the end of betting operations in Brazil and the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Our Lady of Aparecida. The growth also occurs among evangelicals and women, strategic segments for re-election.

item.title: Maioria não vê possibilidade de interferência estrangeira nas eleições de 2026, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 51% of Brazilians believe foreign countries cannot interfere in the 2026 elections, while 41% think such influence is possible. The topic reflects concerns about electoral security and transparency.

item.title: Drible ao sistema do STF permite que ministros tomem decisões em processos sem sorteio de relator
item.description: Supreme Court justices use a procedural maneuver to rule on cases without being rapporteurs, bypassing the Internal Rules, causing tension with the Electoral Court. Recent cases involving Flávio Dino, Gilmar Mendes, and André Mendonça exemplify this workaround, where requests are embedded into ongoing cases to select a favorable judge.

item.title: Quando será o 5º dia útil em outubro?
item.description: The fifth business day of October 2026 will be Tuesday, October 6, considering the labor calendar and the national holiday on Sunday, October 4. Employers must deposit salaries by this date according to Brazilian labor law.

item.title: Governo monitora rede que divulga bets e derruba 506 sites
item.description: A federal government task force took down 506 websites suspected of irregular online betting offerings after the provisional measure banning sports betting in Brazil was issued. The Ministry of Justice and Public Security expanded digital monitoring of the betting market, in partnership with the Ministry of Finance. The Ciberlab identified betting advertisements on Meta, Google, and TikTok platforms, with ads offering bonuses and incentives for new registrations.

item.title: Desenrola Brasil 3.0: veja como funciona novo programa para renegociar dívidas
item.description: President Lula announced Desenrola Brasil 3.0, a program to buy personal debts with discounts exceeding 90%. Created by provisional decree, it may benefit up to 15 million debtors with debts under R$10,000, covering both local and federal budgets.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre desistência de Salles: ‘gesto de grandeza em nome de um projeto maior’
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas thanked Ricardo Salles for withdrawing his Senate candidacy, calling it a gesture of 'greatness' for a greater project. Salles’ exit was seen as a strategy to redirect votes to Derrite and Prado, strengthening the conservative wing against Marina Silva and Simone Tebet.

item.title: Tarcísio elogia Salles por desistir de candidatura ao Senado: "Grandeza"
item.description: Ricardo Salles withdrew his Senate candidacy in São Paulo to support Guilherme Derrite and André do Prado, a move praised by Tarcísio de Freitas as a gesture of 'greatness' to unite the right-wing front. The decision strengthens conservative candidates in the race for the two Senate seats, with Salles thanking the governor for remaining an 'anti-left fortress'. The latest Datafolha poll placed him fifth with 4% of voter intentions.

item.title: Proibição das bets bate recorde e supera crise entre Moraes e Mendonça nas redes
item.description: President Lula's ban on online betting generated the largest wave of social media reactions in the past 12 months, surpassing even the Supreme Court ministers Moraes and Mendonça crisis. Within 63 hours, 2.5 million posts and 40 million interactions were recorded, with 57% of posts opposing the measure but 52% of interactions supporting the ban.

item.title: As regiões do Rio que recebem atenção especial de Paes e Ruas
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Douglas Ruas (PL) focus their gubernatorial campaigns on the West Zone of Rio de Janeiro and the Baixada Fluminense, regions with a strong conservative electorate that supported Jair Bolsonaro in 2022. Paes emphasizes local alliances and public events, while Ruas targets Bolsonaro voters to expand his base and force a runoff. Both strategies aim to capture demographics that significantly backed Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Bispo critica clã Bolsonaro após Flávio acusar CNBB de divulgar fake news
item.description: Bishop Dom Vicente Ferreira criticized the Bolsonaro clan after Flávio Bolsonaro accused CNBB of spreading fake news regarding the alleged removal of Our Lady of Aparecida as patron saint. CNBB denied involvement in misinformation, while judicial authorities became involved in analyzing related posts. The incident reflects tensions between religious and political sectors during the election campaign.

item.title: Entidades vão ao STF para suspender MP de Lula que proíbe as bets
item.description: Industry entities filed a lawsuit at the STF to suspend the provisional measure banning online betting in Brazil, under the rapporteurship of Luiz Fux. While no decision is made, websites and apps must shut down by October 6th. The measure went into effect on September 25th and requires congressional approval within 120 days.

item.title: Flávio pede a Fux que suspenda decisão de Dino sobre fake news de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked Minister Luiz Fux to suspend Flávio Dino's decision overturning the TSE order to remove fake news posts about Nossa Senhora Aparecida. The request aims to protect campaign operations and challenges electoral censorship.

item.title: A realidade paralela do eleitor de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Despite being aware of Flávio Bolsonaro's conversations with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, his voters continue to support him, revealing a political base that tolerates questionable practices. Surveys show that over half of informed voters approve or justify the act of requesting money from Vorcaro, highlighting a parallel reality where the merit of the action is overlooked and denial followed by externalizing blame is part of an established political strategy.

item.title: A disputa Lula X Flávio no maior colégio do Nordeste a 5 dias da eleição, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A poll by Real Time Big Data shows Lula with 61% of voting intentions against 24% for Flávio Bolsonaro in Bahia, the largest electoral college in Northeast Brazil. The 37-point lead is maintained in the second round, with Lula reaching 64% and Flávio 28%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Fux suspensão de decisão de Dino que liberou publicações sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested Minister Fux to suspend Flávio Dino's decision that allowed publications about Our Lady of Aparecida. The request was filed with the STF on September 28, 2026.

item.title: Tarcísio usa desistência de Salles para defender ‘gesto’ de Zema e Caiado contra PT no 1º turno
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas used Ricardo Salles' Senate withdrawal to urge the right to unite behind Flávio Bolsonaro and prevent President Lula from winning in the first round. He emphasized the 'mathematical' aspect of elections and called for setting aside ideological differences to defeat the PT. Zema's team said the candidate will not quit, while Caiado's campaign has not yet responded.

item.title: Governo derruba 506 sites com oferta de bets e deve convocar bigtechs para combater anúncios
item.description: The federal government shut down 506 suspected illegal betting websites and is preparing a technical meeting with major digital platforms to combat online betting ads following the publication of the provisional measure banning this practice in Brazil. The action is part of the monitoring strategy by the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Justice to interrupt access to unauthorized platforms and ensure ad removal by October 5th.

item.title: Governo Lula admite risco de aporte em estatal militar, e lista de empresas em dificuldade sobe a 12
item.description: The Lula government admits the possibility of providing financial support to Emgepron, a military state company facing cash flow issues. The company is responsible for building ships for the Brazilian Navy. This situation highlights challenges in managing public companies linked to security.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acusa CNBB de participar de fake news; bispos dizem que ‘mentira não se combate com mentira’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the CNBB of participating in fake news about Nossa Senhora Aparecida, claiming the PT and internal CNBB members propagated it. The CNBB denied involvement, stating 'lies don't fight lies', while GloboNews clarified no such bill exists. The TSE ordered removal of posts linking the Bolsonaro family to the alleged mobilization.

item.title: O Brasil que vai votar cansado
item.description: The article depicts the wear and hardship experienced by the Brazilian population, illustrated by a market scene where a mother has to deny her child a chocolate due to financial constraints. This scenario symbolizes Brazil heading to the polls in the 2026 election, marked by dissatisfaction and expectations for real changes.

item.title: Brasileiros têm R$ 1,7 bi nas bets, que estão proibidas: veja como e até quando é possível resgatar
item.description: President Lula issued a provisional measure banning online betting and fixed-odds games in Brazil, impacting R$1.7 billion in customer balances. Platforms must allow withdrawals until October 5, with full suspension of operations by October 6. The measure aims to prevent social risks and over-indebtedness but faces resistance from industry-linked groups.

item.title: Candidatos ao governo de São Paulo (SP); veja nome e número
item.description: São Paulo, Brazil's largest electoral college with over 34 million voters, will elect its governor among seven candidates on October 4, 2026. Voting order includes governor, senators, state and federal deputies, and president. Voters should note candidate numbers on their voting guide and verify photo, name, and party before confirming.

item.title: Quando saem as últimas pesquisas presidenciais antes do 1º turno da eleição
item.description: In the final week before the first round of the 2026 elections, several opinion polls will be released between September 28 and October 3, including Quaest, Nexus, Vox Brasil, Datafolha, and Real Time Big Data. The main surveys indicate a competitive race with technical ties in both first and second rounds among the 13 presidential candidates. These polls are essential for mapping the dynamics of the presidential race and providing updated information to voters ahead of October 4.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal do Paraná (PR); veja nome e número
item.description: The 2026 elections in Paraná include the race for federal deputy, with 30 seats up for grabs. Voters must enter the four-digit candidate number, verify the displayed information, and confirm their vote. The full list of candidates and the status of each nomination can be checked on the TSE website.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal da Bahia (BA); veja nome e número
item.description: The 2026 elections in October will elect federal deputies in Bahia, with 39 seats in the Chamber of Deputies. Voters must use four-digit numbers to cast their votes, after verifying the candidate's name, party, and photo. The full list can be checked on the TSE website and O GLOBO.

item.title: Senado por São Paulo (SP); veja os números e nomes dos candidatos
item.description: In the 2026 elections, 15 candidates compete for two Senate seats in São Paulo, Brazil's largest electoral college with over 34 million voters. Voters must enter a three-digit number and confirm their choice, selecting among figures like André do Prado (PL, 222) and Dra. Eliana Ferreira (PSTU, 161). The vote takes place on October 4th in the first round, and elected senators will oversee the Executive, create parliamentary committees, and influence appointments to the Supreme Court and the Attorney General's Office.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual em Minas Gerais (MG): veja nome e número
item.description: The article reports on the race for state deputy in Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections, with 77 seats contested at ALMG. It explains the voting process, how to verify candidate data and the possible situations of candidacies according to the TSE.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest da eleição presidencial sai nesta segunda (28)
item.description: Quaest releases new presidential poll commissioned by Globo and O Globo, showing Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 33% in the first round, with a technical tie between them in the second round. The survey, conducted between September 24-27, measures the effects of Lula's recent ban on electoral betting and has a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Reta final das eleições tem 'guerra jurídica' entre presidenciáveis; TSE já recebeu ao menos 450 ações
item.description: In the final stretch of the 2026 presidential election, candidates escalated a legal battle at the TSE and STF, with at least 450 lawsuits filed against opponents. Lula da Silva leads with 256 actions against Flávio Bolsonaro, who counters with 93 lawsuits. Disputes involve early campaigning, AI usage, political favoritism accusations, and probes into ties with jailed figures.

item.title: Avaliação de Lula não melhora durante a campanha, mostram pesquisas; saiba como foi com outros presidentes
item.description: Surveys indicate that President Lula's government approval has not improved during the electoral campaign, breaking the historical trend seen with other incumbent candidates seeking re-election. Lula's campaign struggles to boost his ratings amid internal and external criticism, including accusations from Flávio Bolsonaro that recent measures constitute 'electoral fraud'.

item.title: VÍDEO: O que está em jogo nas eleições para o Senado?
item.description: The 2026 Senate elections will contest 54 of the 81 seats and may redefine the composition of the Senate, impacting the analysis of presidential appointments to the Supreme Court and impeachment processes. The Senate holds exclusive powers, such as approving by absolute majority appointments for judicial and diplomatic positions. The electoral result will influence the dynamics between the Powers of the Republic in the coming years.

item.title: Quando serão as eleições 2026? Veja as datas do 1º e 2º turno
item.description: The 2026 elections will take place on October 4th (first round) and October 25th (second round, if needed), featuring voting for president, governor, senators, deputies, and state positions. The TSE set the dates and advises voters to bring a paper note with candidate numbers to facilitate voting.

item.title: Lula diz acreditar na inocência de Lulinha e de seu ex-chefe de gabinete
item.description: President Lula stated he believes in the innocence of his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva and former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, who are under investigation over influence peddling allegations involving businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger. He emphasized that they should be investigated but affirmed he will not intervene to protect them.

item.title: “Mexer com Nossa Senhora Aparecida não é aceitável”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula defended Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint during an interview with Band, amid controversy over fake news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro proposed removing the saint's title. The senator strongly denied the accusations and accused the PT of spreading disinformation. The discussion also involved the CNBB, which denied involvement in spreading the conspiracy theory.

item.title: Rodoviários suspendem greve após acordo com as empresas de ônibus
item.description: The bus drivers' union in Brasília suspended a planned strike after reaching an agreement with bus companies and the Secretariat of Mobility, securing an 8% salary increase and 10% for meal tickets and the basket. The decision prevents public transport disruption, with Governor Celina Leão highlighting the role of the labor court and the Public Prosecutor's Office.

item.title: Juristas veem 'precedente perigoso' em decisão de Dino que anulou veto de Mendonça a post sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino annulled a decision by former Minister André Mendonça (TSE) ordering the removal of a post by Antônio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida, deeming the restriction a violation of freedom of expression and religion. The ruling split jurists, with some criticizing Dino's approach as a 'dangerous precedent' for electoral justice.

item.title: Bets suspendem parceria com governo de combate a sites clandestinos
item.description: The ANJL suspended its partnership with the federal government to combat illegal betting sites after MP 1.394/2026 banned fixed-odds betting nationwide. Companies are considering mobilizing to overturn the measure, amid a 141% surge in illegal sites. The suspension follows the ban on new bets and the October 5 deadline for balance withdrawals.

item.title: Lula defende mandato no STF e não promete mulher na vaga
item.description: In an interview with Band, President Lula advocated for establishing term limits for Supreme Court justices and proposed that appointments involve civil society and a specialized committee. He did not commit to nominating a woman for the vacant seat, stating that selections should prioritize the qualifications and needs of candidates, and rejected allocating positions based solely on gender or ethnic representation.

item.title: AGU pede ao STF que celular continue com internet mesmo após fim da franquia nas eleições
item.description: The AGU requested that the STF ensure internet access for mobile devices with exhausted data during elections, in a lawsuit filed by the Green Party and CNTE. The measure would cover 72 hours before to 24 hours after each round, with possible speed reduction. Anatel and Conexis warn about network congestion and technical impossibility of implementing the change in a short timeframe.

item.title: Flávio diz que CNBB ajudou PT a espalhar fake news sobre padroeira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the PT and CNBB of spreading fake news about a supposed intention to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as patron saint of Brazil. CNBB rejected the accusations, stating it did not produce or authorize false information and does not engage in political structures. As CNBB said, a lie is not combated with another lie.

item.title: “Se me deu whisky, já bebi”, diz Lula sobre advogado de Vorcaro
item.description: President Lula told the Band that if he received whisky from lawyer Walfrido Warde, he drank it, but denied knowing messages attributed to the defender of Daniel Vorcaro. Lula said the meeting with Vorcaro occurred only once, in December 2024, with no intermediation or gift. The Presidency noted the meeting was arranged through official contacts and that any accusations require technical analysis by the Central Bank.

item.title: Lula diz que não sabe se polêmica envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora é notícia falsa
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with BandNews that he does not know whether the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady is fake news, but emphasized that it is unacceptable to mess with the country's patron saint. The wave of fake news alleged that Flávio had removed the title of Our Lady of Aparecida.

item.title: Lula quer mudar o critério de indicação de ministros ao STF e sugere a criação de um conselho
item.description: President Lula proposed changes to the criteria for appointing Supreme Court justices, suggesting the creation of a council with legal entities to participate in the process. He criticized judges for speaking too much and said internal court discussions should be restricted. Lula also addressed the proximity of authorities to businessman Daniel Vorcaro, calling for investigations.

item.title: Lula diz que Nossa Senhora seguirá como padroeira brasileira
item.description: Lula stated that Our Lady of Aparecida will remain Brazil's patron saint, rejecting rumors linking Flávio Bolsonaro to a title removal proposal. He noted the cited measure dates back to 2007 and was shelved, emphasizing interfaith respect.

item.title: Ministro de Lula repudia fala de Flávio sobre CNBB ajudar em fake news sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Lula's Minister of Justice, Jorge Messias, rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) claims that the PT and CNBB spread false information about removing Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint. Flávio's statement, made at an event in Goiânia, was deemed false and sparked over 1 million social media posts. Messias emphasized the CNBB's role in defending a secular state and democracy.

item.title: Haddad diz que 'até a mãe de Cristo não escapou do bolsonarismo' e ataca Tarcísio
item.description: PT gubernatorial candidate Fernando Haddad stated at a São Paulo event with Lula that 'even Christ's mother couldn't escape Bolsonarism,' criticizing disrespect toward faith and women. The remark, made during the 'Juntas com Haddad e Lula' rally in Praça da Sé, targeted Tarcísio and the Bolsonarist legacy.

item.title: Flávio diz que ala da CNBB articulou com PT fake news sobre N. S. Aparecida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused members of CNBB of conspiring with PT to spread fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida. The allegation was made during his tenure as senator and presidential candidate for PL. CNBB has not officially commented on the accusation so far.
